name: ASIAPAC
recent: ASIAPAC 近期宣布以 4209 万令吉收购彭亨关丹约 21.48 英亩租赁土地，并与 KotaSAS 签订联合开发协议开发约 28.20 英亩土地；同时以 8769 万令吉出售雪兰莪士毛月约 35.72 公顷永久土地。公司于 2026 年 9 月 9 日召开第 108 届常年股东大会，所有普通决议案均获通过。
notable: 全资子公司 Wangsa Masyhur Sdn Bhd 与 KotaSAS Sdn Bhd 签订买卖协议，以 4209 万令吉现金收购彭亨关丹约 21.48 英亩租赁土地。
全资子公司 Everest Pioneer Sdn Bhd 与 KotaSAS Sdn Bhd 签订联合开发协议，分三期开发约 28.20 英亩土地。
全资子公司 BH Builders Sdn Bhd 与 Kueen Lai Properties Sdn Bhd 签订买卖协议，以 8769 万令吉现金出售雪兰莪士毛月约 35.72 公顷永久土地。

recent_en: ASIAPAC recently announced the acquisition of approximately 21.48 acres of leasehold land in Kuantan, Pahang for RM42.09 million, and entered into a joint development agreement with KotaSAS to develop approximately 28.20 acres of land; it also proposed to dispose of approximately 35.72 hectares of freehold land in Semenyih, Selangor for RM87.69 million. The company held its 108th Annual General Meeting on 9 September 2026, where all ordinary resolutions were approved.
notable_en: Wholly-owned subsidiary Wangsa Masyhur Sdn Bhd entered into a sale and purchase agreement with KotaSAS Sdn Bhd to acquire approximately 21.48 acres of leasehold land in Kuantan, Pahang for RM42.09 million cash.
Wholly-owned subsidiary Everest Pioneer Sdn Bhd entered into a joint development agreement with KotaSAS Sdn Bhd to develop approximately 28.20 acres of land in three phases.

Wholly-owned subsidiary BH Builders Sdn Bhd entered into a sale and purchase agreement with Kueen Lai Properties Sdn Bhd to dispose of approximately 35.72 hectares of freehold land in Semenyih, Selangor for RM87.69 million cash.
